notes: Retained six transparent wyrm gore splat assets.
Adjusted wyrm death effect to use many smaller scattered pieces instead of one dominant central splat.
Fixed late killZombie override so the wyrm gore effect actually triggers when the street wyrm dies.
Patched the final active render override to call drawWyrmSplat(), fixing an effect that was triggered but never drawn.
Restricted Wyrm death effect to the actual Street Wyrm only.
Removed procedural fallback/blobs so the death effect now uses only the image-based splat assets.
Increased image-based Wyrm death splat density, scale, opacity, and linger for a more graphic full-screen effect.
Adjusted army fort prop sort ordering so army sprites no longer draw over characters.
Replaced the badly cropped Sax Eddie idle frame with a clean full-frame idle image.
Swapped Lady Boom and Angie recruit waiting portraits to the updated title-screen portrait art.
Swapped SK8 Kid recruit waiting portrait to the updated title-screen portrait art.
Raised the active survivor follower cap from 5 to 8.
Expanded companion formation to eight unique follower slots.
Updated the crew HUD to display up to eight saved survivors.
Added zombie spatial lookup grid for companion, civilian, and army targeting.
Throttled distant zombie AI updates so offscreen enemies think less often.
Cached army fort layouts and combined fort-prop tile arrays.
Reduced rain density modestly to improve frame rate while preserving the visual style.
Fixed duplicate team joins by assigning unique recruit IDs and spawning each saved crew entry exactly once.
Converted companion contact and most companion area-attack scans to the zombie spatial grid.
Staggered companion contact checks to reduce eight-follower frame spikes.
Reduced active survivor team cap from 8 to 6.
Adjusted follower formation to six slots.
Added settle/snap logic so followers stop jittering when the player stops.
Follower formation now rotates smoothly with the player movement direction instead of only left/right facing.
Added lightweight corner steering so followers prefer walkable axis routes instead of cutting directly through blocked corners.
Reduced companion separation force to prevent clumping without causing shove/jitter behavior.
Added visible BUILD v173 marker to the title screen.
Follower ceiling is six total visible followers, including the rescued escort princess.
Recruitable survivor types cannot repeat while an earlier copy is still alive; that type becomes eligible again after the follower dies.
Punk Prom Queen is mission-critical and no longer consumes one of the six normal follower slots; rescuing her can temporarily bring total followers to seven.
Prevented two recruitable survivors in the same room from spawning on the exact same survivor spot; second recruit is suppressed if only one valid spot exists. Title screen updated to BUILD v175.
Updated visible title-screen build label to v176.
Added desktop pointer lock during gameplay; Escape releases the mouse.
Pointer lock releases automatically for title screen, upgrades, victory, and game-over UI.
Throttled routine HUD DOM updates to roughly 12 Hz.
Cached minimap rendering and refreshes it at roughly 10 Hz or immediately when its state changes.
Fixed minimap flicker by replacing framebuffer pixel caching with cached minimap tile data.
Updated the browser tab title and visible title-screen badge to v178.
Restored follower combat targeting by rebuilding the zombie spatial grid in the final Street Wyrm-aware zombie updater.
Assigned recruit survivor identities at room generation so two recruits in one room cannot be the same survivor type.
Waiting recruit props now keep their assigned identity and disappear when that survivor type is already alive on the team.
Updated visible title-screen and browser-tab version labels to v179.
Added fixed rest anchors for followers after the player stops, eliminating stationary path/separation micro-jitter.
Rest-locked followers receive no path steering, separation force, or movement integration until movement/combat requires it.
Follower combat targeting from v179 remains active.
Updated title-screen and browser-tab version labels to v180.
Updated both title-screen and runtime browser-tab version to v181.
Eliminated stationary follower sprite jitter by using a fixed idle frame with no idle bob.
Minimap recruit cache now keys off rescued recruit IDs and currently blocked survivor identities to prevent stale yellow recruit markers.

Replaced the title-screen background and title logo art with new Ruby at the End of the World branding.
